featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry

Overall output was unusable and disappointing

As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.

This is a clear case of non-payment. A clear message was sent regarding over time charges long before the shoot. We have proof. Still we gave them a revised quote adding our non payment dues from first project which they did not agree. 

It is important to note that the client approached us repeatedly over and over again for a second project solely based on the quality of our work. We have proof. However, since we did not respond on their terms after the payment issue, they are now attempting to defame us with false information. 

We have never experienced such clients in our decade long experience. Such clients are placed on our blacklist, and we also caution fellow photographers to be very careful in accepting assignments from EuroKids Rustomjee, Dahisar. 

We remain focused on delivering high-quality work and maintaining strong, professional relationships with our valued clients.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was eight months pregnant last year when I got in touch with Anupa for my shoot. I stay in Ahmedabad so Anupa had to travel here for a day from Bombay.
It was monsoon time and of course the rain played truant with our outdoor shoot plans.
However Anupa was a rockstar and a brilliant photographer. She worked with the rain and shot the most beautiful pictures of me with my bump. She was aware of my tiredness and the time crunch - we only had a day- and managed to get all the shots I wanted and some more ! We had an indoor shoot after and my space had a lot of lighting constraints for her. Yet she thought on her feet and delivered the loveliest pictures of me. The best part is her creative use of any space she shoots in. She uses it thoroughly to her advantage and comes up with brilliant shots. Absolute genius!
It’s been 8 months since we shot together and I find myself often looking back on the pictures she took. I look radiant happy and to my eyes beautiful. I credit this solely to Anupa. She didn’t get frazzled with the rain, with my exhaustion, with the time crunch or space constraints. She worked with everything like a pro and delivered the best to me. Additionally she has the kindest attitude and coolest temperament. I am not fond of shoots and I am also camera shy. But with gentle and intelligent coaxing she got me to emote and actually enjoy myself during the shoot.
After a long time in the pregnancy I felt good and a bit like myself. I recommend Anupa blindly to anyone looking for a photographer to not only capture them at their best but to make them feel beautiful about themselves.
I am waiting for her to do my baby shoot next!
